text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Right-wing Disy party is to debate the results of the municipal elections.
- Publicity around planned purchase of the S300 missile system may create over-optimism among public of its capabilities, and push its price up by the Russians.
- Paphos woman is pregnant with 11 babies.
- A billion pound defence plan is to go ahead.
- Hellenic Chemicals may resume fertiliser production after interest shown by Ukrainian businessmen.
- Telecommunications authority workers declare a one hour work stoppage over delays in submission of supplementary budget to parliament on their pay rises.
- Missiles, more T-80U tanks and light aircraft are among purchases planned in the new five-year defence programme.
